title: Dynamo v1.6.0-muse-spark-open-dev.1
text:
Release Notes
Dynamo v1.6.0-muse-spark-open-dev.1 is an experimental snapshot build with early Meta Muse Spark Open support on the Dynamo SGLang, vLLM, and TensorRT-LLM backends. It is not recommended for production and is not a QA-gated release. APIs, behavior, and defaults may change before stable support. Use it for evaluation, testing, and early feedback only.
Summary
Dynamo v1.6.0-muse-spark-open-dev.1 adds serving for meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4 on Dynamo SGLang (recommended), vLLM, and TensorRT-LLM. The frontend gains the muse_spark reasoning and tool-call parsers, plus Responses API support for native, deferred, and custom tools, commentary streaming, conversation replay, and client tool search. The vLLM and SGLang containers are built on digest-pinned public Muse Spark Open model images (#16700).
Kubernetes recipes cover ten GB200 and GB300 targets: six SGLang (aggregated, 1P1D disaggregated, and KV-aware routed), two vLLM aggregated, and two TensorRT-LLM aggregated. All use TP4/EP4 with an FP8 KV cache and a 1M-token context, with shared model-cache manifests and an AIPerf agentic trace benchmark under recipes/muse-spark-open-816b-a42b (#16553, #16557, #16567, brought onto this branch by #16856).

About Muse Spark Open
Muse Spark Open is a Meta mixture-of-experts model (816B total parameters, 42B active) published as meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4 (NVFP4). This build serves it through Dynamo's SGLang, vLLM, and TensorRT-LLM backends, with aggregated, disaggregated, and KV-aware routed serving on SGLang and aggregated serving on vLLM and TensorRT-LLM.
Full Changelog
Frontend and Responses API
Muse Spark Open parsers: Added the muse_spark reasoning and tool-call parsers on the unified parser path. Parser, protocol, and renderer crates are pinned to published versions across the root, Python, and KVBM workspaces, including dynamo-parsers =8.2.0-muse-spark-open-dev.1 (#16700).
Tools: Native, deferred, and custom tool support, with expanded tool_choice handling (#16700).
Responses API: Commentary-phase streaming, conversation history replay, and client-side tool-search handling (#16700).
SGLang Backend
Muse Spark Open runtime: Built on a digest-pinned public SGLang model image, with compatibility fixes for the multimodal encode worker, argument handling, and model registration (#16700).
vLLM Backend
Muse Spark Open runtime: Built on a digest-pinned public vLLM model image that preserves the model's dependency combination. vLLM-Omni is disabled for this release and unused InstantTensor is removed.
Backend compatibility: Fixes for the embedding worker, renderer, and KV-event APIs, and an explicit imageio>=2.37.0 requirement for video request processing (#16700).
TensorRT-LLM Backend
TensorRT-LLM 1.3.0rc25: Runtime on the 1.3.0rc25 release image with LLM worker updates and unit tests (#16700).
Containers
Compliance: Stricter license and attribution auditing for the shipped images, including exact Rust/Go binary dependencies, Python environments, and removal of unneeded development packages from the SGLang base. Native amd64 and arm64 final-image audits are required (#16700).
Recipes
Muse Spark Open recipes: Added recipes/muse-spark-open-816b-a42b with shared model-cache PVC and download job, six SGLang targets (aggregated, 1P1D disaggregated with NIXL, and KV-aware routed on GB200 and GB300), two experimental vLLM aggregated targets, and a perf/trace reference (#16553) (recipe folder, README).
TensorRT-LLM recipes: Added experimental aggregated TensorRT-LLM targets for GB200 and GB300 (#16567).
Display name: Capitalized "Open" in the recipe display name (#16557).
Getting Started
Deployment is Kubernetes-based (Dynamo Platform + DynamoGraphDeployment). Full steps (namespace, Hugging Face token secret, model-cache PVC, model download job, DGD apply, and a /v1/chat/completions smoke test) are in the recipe README and the linked recipe page. Recipes expect a Hugging Face token secret named hf-token-secret and a ReadWriteMany storage class for the shared-model-cache PVC.
Known Issues / Limitations
Experimental snapshot build, not QA-gated; not for production.
The vLLM and TensorRT-LLM recipes are experimental and aggregated only. Their results cover the first 500 trace requests and are functional validation, not full-trace benchmarks.
SGLang disaggregated recipes do not support video requests (the image has no decord2) or frontend decoding (DYN_SGL_FRONTEND_DECODING=true) for image or video inputs. Use an aggregated SGLang recipe for video.
Disaggregated recipes omit provider-specific networking; configure RDMA for long-context requests. SGLang GB200 recipes and GB300 disaggregated recipes require ComputeDomain with Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA).
The TensorRT-LLM image is arm64 only, matching the GB200 and GB300 recipes.
Targets Hopper and Blackwell GPUs. vLLM serving CI on A100 and L4 hardware hit CUDA no kernel image is available errors, and broader backend serving CI was not fully green at merge of #16700.
